verdict.rationale: The docs confirm Authenticator holds many accounts, including non-Microsoft ones. A single community hands-on report says each entry keeps its issuer and a matching icon, which covers only the service-icon element of the story. Nothing in the pack shows search or folders/groups, so most of the organization story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: search, folders or groups, first-party documentation of service icons, evidence of quick two-tap access at scale.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away

citations.quote: each entry kept its issuer and matching icon
You can use Microsoft Authenticator for multiple accounts, including Microsoft personal accounts; work/school accounts; and non-Microsoft accounts, such as Amazon, Facebook, Instagram and Google.
